channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Nike’s Cleanest ACG Moc Gone Summer-Sweet Frozé Mode
item.description: Nike's ACG Izy zip-up shoe appears in a peachy "Arctic Orange" colorway, joining a stylish lineup for the spring season.

item.title: As a Cowboy Clog, Birkenstock's Boston Looks Insanely Good
item.description: People are so desperate for cowboy-coded Birkenstock Boston clogs that they're making their own. Now, ETRO finally made them a reality.

item.title: Nike's Classic Air Max Is Freshest When Dressed Like Nike's *Other* Classic Air Max
item.description: Nike's Air Max 90 "Neon" sneaker borrows the Air Max 95's iconic look, resulting in a clean & classic take on the model.

item.title: Nike’s Ultra-Stylish, High-Tech ACG Trail Runner Is Literally Down for Whatever
item.description: Nike's ACG Pegasus Trail arrives as newest, most stylish trail sneaker designed to do it all, even beyond the wild.

item.title: adidas’ Brunch-Ready Samba Is Straight from the Chocolate Factory
item.description: adidas' Samba LX Freizeit sneaker gets a delicious brown leather makeover. The results are a chocolatey take on the "dress shoe" model.

item.title: adidas’ Italian Sneaker Looks Best in a Canadian Tuxedo
item.description: adidas introduces its retro Italia 70s sneaker in denim, creating the most stylish version of the model yet.

item.title: Stone Island Created New Balance’s Softest Sneaker Ever
item.description: Stone Island Ghost went to unprecedented lengths in making New Balance’s classic 574 sneaker a cohesive monomaterial shoe.

item.title: Vans’ Cute Mary Jane Sneaker Has Been Hiding Its Not-So-Secret Grungy Side
item.description: The Vans Mary Jane Lo Pro Studded boasts a tactile velvet upper in a beautiful olive hue.

item.title: Nike's Ultra-Functional GORE-TEX Boot Is a Tactical Beast
item.description: Nike's hardcore GORE-TEX Camo SFB Air Field Ukiah R boot was literally made with the military in mind.

item.title: “You Just Do the Work and Let it Go”: Marni’s Meryll Rogge on Her Excellent Debut
item.description: Marni’s new creative director discusses her first show, her Dries Van Noten and Marc Jacobs upbringing, and being one of few women at the top.
